title: Q-KIT-AUTO-IMPROVE-1: carry AUTO-IMPROVE-1 into the seed kit
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** executor tick, driver order
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation systemspec --rule AUTO-IMPROVE-1
**Status:** open

SYSTEM-SPEC-1: the standing rule AUTO-IMPROVE-1 is enforced only by the platform. A system built from the seed inherits the rule as an instruction but has no code in the kit that enforces it.

Ship the check or loop that enforces AUTO-IMPROVE-1 into seed/ (a script under seed/scripts/, a tick step under seed/worker/src/, or a test under seed/tests/), add its probe to kit_enforcement in seed/autonomy/system.json, and remove AUTO-IMPROVE-1 from not_in_kit.

Prediction: kit_rules_not_enforced <= 16 within 168 h

**Out of scope:** changing the rule's wording in agents/AGENTS.md, or moving the platform's own check out of foundation/.

size: M

**Closing probe:** `python3 -m foundation systemspec --rule AUTO-IMPROVE-1` exits 0: the spec holds and AUTO-IMPROVE-1 is enforced inside the kit.
